changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: update merchant_capability_extension capability_extension set merchant_capability_id = parent.id, extension_capability_name = child.name from merchant_capability child cross join merchant_capability parent where child.id = capability_extension.merchant_capability_id and parent.merchant_id = child.merchant_id and parent.name = capability_extension.extension_capability_name and ( parent.version = child.version or ( parent.version = '' and not exists ( select 1 from merchant_capability same_version_parent where same_version_parent.merchant_id = child.merchant_id and same_version_parent.name = capability_extension.extension_capability_name and same_version_parent.version = child.version ) ) )
